name: ActionBar
label: Action bar
description: A bar docked to the bottom of a long list or form, with a summary line and the primary actions over a progressive blur.

props.name: summary
props.description:
The summary line at the bar's start, such as "23 students still to
mark". It is a polite live region, so a count that changes while the
reader works is announced once it settles.

props.name: actions
props.description:
The actions at the bar's end, typically one or two Buttons with the
primary action last. On a narrow bar they wrap below the summary and
hold the end edge.

props.name: sticky
props.description:
Whether the bar holds to the bottom of its scroll container while the
content scrolls under it. Off, it sits in flow after the content.

props.name: blur
props.description:
Whether the content fades under a progressive blur that reaches above
the bar. Off, the bar is a solid surface with a hairline at its top
edge.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the root.

keys.note: The bar adds no keys of its own: its actions are buttons, and the browser owns Tab, Enter and Space.

alternatives.name: Toolbar
alternatives.when: the controls act on a canvas or a view and sit together in one pill, rather than closing out a list

alternatives.name: TableToolbar
alternatives.when: the bar sits over a table and holds its search, filters and view settings
